name: antigravity
description: Run the Antigravity CLI (Gemini) as a collaborating AI inside Claude Code, with intelligent model routing across the SDLC. Claude conducts — requirements, architecture, the hard 20%, verification, review — and routes deterministic, high-volume work (scaffolding, tests, first-pass review, migrations, web/Vertex AI Search) to Antigravity. Hybrid agentic engineering; lower token cost as a financial lever.

model_lock.title: Lock the executor model (on by default)
model_lock.description: on (default): every delegation runs on one model — default_model if set, else Gemini 3.8 Flash (High), the only agy model that works well as an agent. --tier / --model / default_tier are ignored with a note on stderr. off: the upstream tier routing (flash / flash-lo / pro, remappable).

default_tier.title: Default Antigravity tier
default_tier.description: Only with model_lock=off. Tier used by agy-delegate.sh when --tier is not passed. One of: flash (Gemini 3.8 Flash High, default — bulk work), flash-lo (Flash Low, cheapest/trivial), pro (Gemini 3.1 Pro High, harder reasoning).

timeout.title: Default delegation timeout
timeout.description: Default agy print-mode timeout when --timeout is not passed, e.g. 5m, 10m, 300s.

job_timeout.title: Background job timeout
job_timeout.description: Timeout for agy-job runs that do not pass --timeout, e.g. 30m, 1h. A job cut off by it can be resumed with --continue.

isolation.title: Jail agy in bubblewrap (Linux; always on by default)
isolation.description: workspace (default): run agy inside a bubblewrap jail — the filesystem read-only except the current repository, --dir paths and ~/.gemini; private /tmp; ~/.ssh, ~/.aws and other credential dirs hidden — with --dangerously-skip-permissions inside it, so writes, shell commands, web search and URL reads work headless without permissions.allow rules or --yolo. The network stays open. Without bwrap the wrapper refuses (exit 16) instead of running agy unjailed. readonly: only --dir paths writable. auto: jail when bwrap is available, else plain agy. off: plain agy (upstream behavior).

shared_caches.title: Share package caches with the jail
shared_caches.description: When on (default), the workspace jail can write the real uv, pip, go-build, npm, cargo, Go module, Gradle and Maven caches that exist, so agy does not download everything again. Other tools that follow XDG write to a private jail cache (~/.cache/agy-jail). A cache the jail writes can later run outside it, so set off/false/0/no to give agy only the private cache.

isolation_writable.title: Extra writable paths in the jail
isolation_writable.description: Space-separated extra directories the workspace jail may write (~ allowed), for tools that keep a cache outside ~/.cache and are not in the built-in list. Never add credential directories. When agy hits a read-only path, the wrapper names it and points here.

work_rules.title: Append work rules to every task
work_rules.description: When on (default), agy-delegate appends a short rule block to each task: never weaken tests or loosen thresholds, report only observed results, say when less was done than asked, leave no scratch files, run commands in the foreground (never background one and wait on it), do not edit project config to work around the jail, end with a report of files changed and commands run. Set to off/false/0/no to send the task text unchanged.

coding_policy.title: Inject routing policy at session start
coding_policy.description: When on, a SessionStart hook injects this plugin's cost-aware routing policy (delegate above the break-even, keep Claude's context lean, always verify agy's output) as session context, so the discipline applies without invoking the skill. Set to off/false/0/no to suppress.

default_model.title: Default executor model (exact agy model name)
default_model.description: agy is multi-model. Set an exact model name from `agy models` (e.g. a Claude/GPT model on plans that expose them) to use as the executor when --tier/--model are not passed. Leave empty to use the tier mapping (Gemini by default). The 'Claude conducts, a different/cheaper model executes' design gives the cost + cross-model-verification benefit, so a non-Claude executor is recommended.

tier_flash.title: Model for the 'flash' tier
tier_flash.description: Override the exact agy model the 'flash' tier maps to (default: Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)). Use a name from `agy models`.

tier_flash_lo.title: Model for the 'flash-lo' tier
tier_flash_lo.description: Override the exact agy model the 'flash-lo' tier maps to (default: Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low)). Use a name from `agy models`.

tier_pro.title: Model for the 'pro' tier
tier_pro.description: Override the exact agy model the 'pro' tier maps to (default: Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)). Use a name from `agy models`.

structured_output.title: Use agy's structured JSON output
structured_output.description: When on (default), agy-delegate runs agy with --output-format json (agy >= 1.1.8, requires python3) to classify failures from the structured error and report token usage as an AGY_USAGE line on stderr. The text on stdout is unchanged. Set to off/false/0/no to force the plain-text path.

digest_warn_chars.title: Digest-size warning threshold (chars)
digest_warn_chars.description: agy-delegate warns on stderr when a reply exceeds this many characters — a raw dump instead of the digest the cost discipline calls for. Empty = 8000. Set 0 to disable.

delegation_nudge.title: Nudge delegation on bulk-looking prompts
delegation_nudge.description: When on, a UserPromptSubmit hook adds a short advisory note to Claude's context when a prompt looks like bulk work above the delegation break-even (mass edits, migrations, exhaustive tests, fan-out search). Advisory only — Claude still makes the break-even judgment per task. Off by default in this fork (delegation is the user's explicit call); set to on/true/1/yes to enable.

usage_log.title: Cost-measurement log file (AGY_USAGE / AGY_SIGNAL)
usage_log.description: Absolute path. When set, every delegation appends its AGY_USAGE (token counts) and AGY_SIGNAL (failure) line to this file in addition to stderr. Use this whenever you are MEASURING cost: stderr is easily lost — piping the wrapper through `2>&1 | tail -N` to keep Claude's context lean keeps the digest and silently drops the usage line, which makes the Gemini side look cheaper than it is. Env AGY_USAGE_LOG overrides this. Empty = off.
